metadata.description: Claude Code mods built as function-hook plugins.

plugins.name: whats-next
plugins.description: A pane in the side panel listing the next steps of your dev workflow, filled by /ask-sean; click a step to see its prompt.

plugins.name: quick-reply
plugins.description: One-click replies above the prompt: the options Claude just offered, Yes, Go with your recommendation, Continue, and the next wayfinder ticket.

plugins.name: auto-resume
plugins.description: When a turn dies on a rate limit (or an overloaded API), counts down to the reset and sends "continue" for you.

plugins.name: github-panel
plugins.description: A GitHub pane in the side panel: the repo's open pull requests and issues; click one to open it in the browser, or fill /implement or /wayfinder with an issue. The issue a /wayfinder run works on is pinned at the top, with its next takeable ticket. A toast when your branch's pull request turns green or red, and a button that fills a fix on red.

plugins.name: shelf
plugins.description: Named folders and files above the prompt: click one to drop its path into what you are typing.

plugins.name: turn-chime
plugins.description: Plays a sound and shows a toast when a long turn ends or Claude stops to ask you something.

plugins.name: open-file-guard
plugins.description: Before Claude uses a Word, Excel or PowerPoint file you have open, asks you to close it instead of letting the write fail.

plugins.name: branch-guard
plugins.description: Before Claude commits or pushes on the default branch, asks you whether to create a branch first.

plugins.name: env-guard
plugins.description: Asks you before Claude reads a .env or key file, and refuses when no one is there to answer.

plugins.name: bash-quoting-rescue
plugins.description: Before a shell command runs, parses it with the shell's own parser and refuses one that does not parse, such as an unclosed quote or heredoc, so none of it runs.

plugins.name: outputs
plugins.description: A pane listing the files this session has made or changed, newest first; click one to open it.

plugins.name: sources
plugins.description: A pane listing the files Claude has read this session, grouped by where they came from, with a lock that keeps reads inside the project folder.

plugins.name: hud
plugins.description: Two coloured, animated lines under the prompt, every figure named: model, effort, context window, rate limits, turn timer, tool calls, agents, git state, cost, session length and folder.

plugins.name: post-merge-cleanup
plugins.description: /cleanup after a PR merges: switch to the default branch, pull, and delete the merged branch and its worktree, after one confirmation.

plugins.name: pre-pr-claims-check
plugins.description: Refuses gh pr create and gh pr edit while the PR's title, its body or the branch's added Markdown lines hold a file:line citation, a placeholder or a count spelled out in words, listing each one.

plugins.name: lint-test-gate
plugins.description: Runs the project's checks from a band button, and before Claude's git commit, and hands back only the failures.

plugins.name: chrome-tab-self-heal
plugins.description: When a Claude in Chrome tool says its tab is gone, tells Claude to fetch the current tab IDs before trying again.

plugins.name: session-auto-namer
plugins.description: After a session's first prompt, a button above the prompt suggests a name for the session, such as an issue's number and title; one press renames it.

plugins.name: mod-settings
plugins.description: A gear at the top right of each mod's pane opens one dialog for every claude-mods setting: pick a mod, change its settings, save.
